biggest_catch: The $650 annual fee nearly eats the whole bonus: 50,000 SkyMiles are worth roughly $600 at ~1.2 cents each, so on miles alone you are $50 UNDERWATER against the fee in year one — the deal only works if the two Delta Comfort round-trip flight certificates are genuinely useful to you (worth up to a few hundred dollars each, minus up to $80/person in taxes and fees, 21+ day advance purchase required). Offer ends 11/4/2026.
catches: Only claim this bonus if you were ALREADY going to spend $10,000 in six months — never spend extra to chase a bonus.
The $650 annual fee eats the bonus: 50,000 miles at ~1.2 cents = ~$600, which is LESS than the $650 fee — the flight certificates must carry the deal.

The two round-trip Delta Comfort Flight Certificates are restricted: valid only for travel to the U.S. 48, Puerto Rico, or the U.S. Virgin Islands; 21+ day advance purchase required; up to $80 per person in taxes and fees apply; other restrictions apply.
Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry.

Once-per-lifetime rule: no welcome offer if you have or have had this Card or previous versions; Amex may also deny based on history and cards opened/closed — you are notified before processing so you can withdraw.
Carrying a balance at ~20%+ APR wipes out the bonus instantly — pay in full.
Fees, interest, cash advances, gift cards, prepaid reloads, and person-to-person payments don't count toward the $10,000 threshold; account must not be cancelled or past due at fulfillment.
